subject: reasoning
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below. (Left) 121 256 812 658 527 (Right) (NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

If all the numbers are arranged in descending order, the position(s) of how many numbers will remain unchanged?
solution:
Given :

(Left) 121 256 812 658 527 (Right) 

Numbers are arranged in descending order,- 812 658 527 256 121

No, numbers will remain unchanged.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
